standard_prerequisites.name: The cone construction on a map of complexes and its functoriality
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the levelwise cones whose totalization is computed.

standard_prerequisites.use: Is the construction being compared, and the place where the degreewise product splitting occurs.

standard_prerequisites.use: Is the criterion that finishes the proof once the cone identification is made.

core_obligations: Recall that the product totalization in degree n is given by the product over p + q = n of A^{p,q} (proof lines 30150-30151).
Let C_p^bullet be the cone on A_p^bullet -> B_p^bullet, and use functoriality of the cone construction to obtain a complex of complexes C_0^bullet -> C_1^bullet -> ... (proof lines 30152-30158).

Compute the degree n part of Tot_pi(C^{bullet,bullet}) as the product over p + q = n of C^q_p, rewrite it as the product over p + q = n of (B^q_p oplus A^{q+1}_p), and split it into the product of the B^q_p and the product of the A^{q+1}_p (proof lines 30159-30165).

Conclude that Tot_pi(C^{bullet,bullet}) is the cone of the map Tot_pi(A^{bullet,bullet}) -> Tot_pi(B^{bullet,bullet}); the author states that the verification that the differentials agree is omitted (proof lines 30166-30169).
Conclude that it suffices to show Tot_pi(A^{bullet,bullet}) is acyclic whenever each A_p^bullet is acyclic, which follows from the vanishing lemma for product totalizations (proof lines 30169-30172).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a map between two complexes of complexes of abelian groups, reinterprets them as double complexes via A^{p,q} = A_p^q and B^{p,q} = B_p^q, forms the product total complexes, and asserts that if each levelwise map A_p^bullet -> B_p^bullet is a quasi-isomorphism then the induced map of product totalizations is a quasi-isomorphism (source lines 30130-30147). The proof is a cone reduction. It recalls that the product totalization in degree n is the product over p + q = n of A^{p,q}, and forms the levelwise cones C_p^bullet, obtaining by functoriality a complex of complexes C_0^bullet -> C_1^bullet -> ... (proof lines 30150-30158). The substantive step is the degreewise computation of Tot_pi(C^{bullet,bullet}): its degree n part is the product over p + q = n of C^q_p, which the proof rewrites as the product of B^q_p and A^{q+1}_p and splits into two products, concluding that Tot_pi(C^{bullet,bullet}) is the cone of the map Tot_pi(A^{bullet,bullet}) -> Tot_pi(B^{bullet,bullet}), with the author stating that the verification that the differentials agree is omitted (proof lines 30159-30169). It therefore suffices to show that Tot_pi(A^{bullet,bullet}) is acyclic whenever each A_p^bullet is acyclic, which follows from the vanishing lemma for product totalizations of acyclic complexes (proof lines 30169-30172). The non-routine content is the degreewise identification of the totalization of the levelwise cones with the cone of the totalizations, which is what reduces the statement to the acyclicity criterion.
